title: New Japan envoy Kitagawa meets Teodoro in first Cabinet call

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Japan’s new ambassador to the Philippines, Katsuro Kitagawa, met with Defense Secretary Gilberto “Gibo” Teodoro Jr. on Wednesday in his first meeting with a Cabinet official, underscoring the priority Manila and Tokyo place on defense and security cooperation. Kitagawa paid an introductory call on Teodoro at the Department of National Defense (DND) headquarters in Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City, on Wednesday, the agency said. During the meeting, Teodoro commended Japan for the successful conduct of the recently concluded Joint Cooperative Activity (JCA) and Future Leaders’ Program (FLP) under the Asean Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus Experts’ Working Group on Maritime Security.
